title: dactylis glomerata subsp. rigida
intro: Dactylis glomerata subsp. rigida, commonly known as Hard Bent or Rigida Bent Grass, is a perennial grass species belonging to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive disorders, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Hard Bent Grass include acting as an anti-inflammatory agent, an antioxidant, and an antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dactylis glomerata subsp. rigida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
